{{Quote|Baroonda is a big super, swampy mess.|[[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]]|<ref name="AS" />}}
'''Baroonda''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of varied geography. It was host to several [[Podracing/Legends|podracing]] tracks which passed through many diverse locations, including [[Volcano/Legends|volcanoes]], swamps, wide, sandy beaches, spectacular waterfalls, thick jungles, [[Sulfur/Legends|sulfur]] geyser fields, and plateau-top [[City/Legends|cities]]. It had some inhabited moons.

==History==
During the [[Galactic War]], the planet featured ancient [[Nazwa]] structures which were largely ignored by the galactic scientific community.<ref name="Mission" />

Around [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] [[C-9979 landing craft/Legends|C-9979 landing craft]] were seen in the skies of Baroonda. This began several rumors about Trade Federation activities on the planet; and one of its eighteen moons was suspected of hosting the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|CIS]], although none of the rumors were substantiated. Podracing was a very popular sport on the planet, and there were several well-known tracks, including [[Baroo Coast/Legends|Baroo Coast]], [[Grabvine Gateway/Legends|Grabvine Gateway]], [[Fire Mountain Rally/Legends|Fire Mountain Rally]] and [[Inferno (track)|Inferno]].
